thread:
maria: Heads-up — customer asked for audit evidence for last 90 days across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. I started a quick coverage scan and found gaps we need to triage before we can say we’re ‘audit-complete’.

ajay: can you paste the gaps list?

maria: Short summary: API gateway missing 'request_id' on 5xx proxy returns, auth missing role-change events for service accounts, console missing user-impersonation events, billing missing chargeback detail for refunded invoices, runtime (inference runtime) not logging KMS key usage on cache-eviction flows. Also schema mismatch: event "role_change" is missing old_role/new_role fields in some services.

taylor: for the API gateway — I think the 5xx path drops request_id when the edge LB rewrites. I can add a middleware to propagate X-Request-Id. Owner: @taylor. ETA: EOW for instrumented PR.

leo: runtime KMS usage — confirmation: we currently log kms operation in async job that only fires on write, not on cache evict/restore. I can add explicit kms_operation logging in runtime eviction path. Need a small KMS helper change. Owner: @leo. ETA: Tue next week.

jen: billing — refunds are created by a scheduled job; job emits invoice_id but not refund_reason/details. I’ll add refund events with refund_reason and line_items fields. Owner: @jen. ETA: Thu.

olivia: auth — service account role changes live in owner service but updates are done via a batch job; batch emits 'service_account_batch_update' but not per-account role_change events. We need to expand the batch to emit per-account role_change events with old_role/new_role and initiator. Owner: @olivia. ETA: Wed.

ajay: I’ll propose schema changes and a compatibility plan. We should add: actor_id, actor_type, resource_type, resource_id, action, outcome, request_id, old_role, new_role, kms_key_id, kms_operation, correlation_id. Also recommend adding an event_version and optional schema_diff field for customer-facing evidence.

maria: sample schema snippet (for review):
```json
{
  "event_type": "role_change",
  "event_version": "v2",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T14:12:00Z",
  "actor_id": "u_123",
  "actor_type": "user",
  "resource_type": "service_account",
  "resource_id": "sa_987",
  "action": "role_update",
  "old_role": "read-only",
  "new_role": "admin",
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "outcome": "success"
}
```

ajay: compatibility note — add event_version and keep v1 behavior for 90 days, backfill where possible. For customer-facing evidence we need deterministic event ids and a proof of existence (hash or signed manifest) for exported bundles.

maria: one more KMS thing — rotation: a customer asked for key-rotation audit trail. We should log kms_key_rotate events with old_key_id and new_key_id and who triggered. @leo please add to runtime and any services that call KMS.

leo: noted. rotation event will be emitted from the KMS wrapper we use. I’ll add old_key_id/new_key_id, rotation_trigger, request_id.

olivia: risk callout — we might need to redact PII in the console events for customer exports. Suggest we add a sanitized payload and full_payload stored in internal-only logs.

maria: agreed. For customer audit bundles we export sanitized events only and include an integrity manifest. Security team to own the manifest design — @ajay.

audit-bot: New ticket created: SEC-4872 — "Audit coverage: per-service gaps + schema v2" assigned to triage group.

ajay: action items summary — create SEC tickets per service: SEC-4873 (api gateway), SEC-4874 (auth), SEC-4875 (console), SEC-4876 (billing), SEC-4877 (runtime kms). I’ll PR schema docs and a migration plan by Mon.

taylor: I’ll link a WIP PR to SEC-4873 when started.

jen: will draft billing event examples for SEC-4876.

leo: will add runtime tests to assert kms_operation is present on evict/restore flows.

maria: follow-ups: 1) owners above to update their SEC ticket with exact endpoints/log lines ± sample event by EOD Wed, 2) ajay to publish schema v2 draft and compatibility windows by Mon, 3) I’ll coordinate customer-facing export format and sign-off once we have schema + evidence.

olivia: noted, I’ll also check RBAC audit queries for customer exports — might need a separate read-only view for evidence.

maria: thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
